title: STOP LAMP SWITCH
summary: Brake light (stop lamp) switch under the dash at the brake pedal: the switch threads through an adjustable bracket on the brake pedal housing and is held by a nut; the bracket is screwed to the pedal housing through slots so it can be set to close the switch at 0.25–0.64 in. of pedal travel. A striker on the pedal arm works the switch, a wire assembly links to the neutral safety switch connector, and a ground wire is screwed to the hinge pillar inner reinforcement.

parts.name: SWITCH ASM.
parts.name_expanded: Switch assembly – stop lamp (brake light switch)

parts.name: STRIKER
parts.name_expanded: Striker – on brake pedal arm, actuates switch

parts.name: WIRE ASM.
parts.name_expanded: Wire assembly – stop lamp switch to neutral safety switch connector

fastening.note: Threaded body of switch [3] passes through the round hole in bracket [6]; nut [5] on the opposite side clamps it. Switch carries its own threads; no separate stud.
Two screws [4] through the upper holes of bracket [6]; bracket is adjusted so the switch makes contact when the pedal is depressed 0.25–0.64 in. (note A).
Bolt [8] with lock washer [7] goes through the pedal housing side plate; nut [10] is shown on the far side of the housing at the same location.
Screw [1] goes through the harness ground wire ring terminal and lock washer [2] into the hinge pillar inner reinforcement.
View A: striker [9] sits on the pedal arm where the switch [3] plunger contacts it; no fastener shown (appears clipped on).
Wire asm [11] plugs between the switch and the neutral safety switch connector.

notes: A: After assembly of the brake pedal, adjust the switch asm. bracket so electrical contact is made when the brake pedal is depressed 0.25 to 0.64 in. from its normal position.
VIEW A: .25 TO .64 from NORMAL POSITION
